title: Tennessee Code Title 50, Chapter 7 - Tennessee Employment Security Law
verified_how: expanded the register's table of contents: 'Title 50 Employer And Employee' > 'Chapter 7 Tennessee Employment Security Law', unmarked, sitting among chs. 1-11 of that Title. No section text was opened; no currency date is published on the table of contents.
notes: Unemployment benefit entitlement, eligibility, disqualification and employer contributions - the most rule-dense everyday benefit statute in the Tennessee Code. Means-tested public assistance is a different Title: Title 71 (Welfare), principally 'Chapter 5 Programs and Services for Poor Persons' (Families First/TANF and food assistance), verified present and unmarked in the register's table of contents but not listed because only one statute per topic is recorded.
